source_document.source_file: Singlife/Medical & Life Insurance/Disability Insurance/Singlife Dementia Cover.md

extraction.document_summary: Singlife Dementia Cover is a long-term care protection plan focused on cognitive decline, with added mental health and certain injury-related support after a dementia diagnosis. It provides annual payouts of up to S$10,000 for cognitive decline/mental health, with “late dementia” Cognitive Care paid over 10 years up to age 99 (the brochure states late-dementia coverage lasts 10 years from diagnosis and the policy terminates after the full Cognitive Care payout). It also includes the Mental Care Benefit for major depressive disorder, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and early/intermediate dementia, paid up to S$50,000 over 5 years. There are also one-time lump-sum payouts up to S$10,000 each for Emotional Resilience (depressive or anxiety disorder) and Medical Expense (accidental burns or fractures). The brochure notes the policy is standalone and not MediSave-approved, and mentions “All age mentioned are Age Next Birthday.”
quality_notes: Brochure clearly states key benefit structures and caps (e.g., up to S$10,000 annual; up to S$50,000 over 5 years; one-time up to S$10,000).
Entry age, premium frequency, underwriting, and renewal/termination conditions beyond the Cognitive Care payout end are not stated in a contract-like way.
No discrete plan tiers (e.g., Plan A/B/C) are named; only a selectable “benefit amount” range (S$200 to S$2,000) is provided.

policies.quick_summary: Long-term care protection plan for dementia-related cognitive decline, with mental health-related payouts and one-time lump sums for emotional resilience and certain accidental medical expenses after dementia diagnosis; coverage extends up to age 99 with late-stage Cognitive Care paid over 10 years (policy terminates after full Cognitive Care payout). It is standalone and not MediSave-approved per brochure notes; ages are Age Next Birthday per disclaimer note. Benefit amount selection described as S$200 to S$2,000, used in payout illustrations up to a total payout cap of S$170,000 based on maximum benefit amount.
coverage_scope: mental health conditions including depressive/anxiety disorder (via Emotional Resilience) and specified disorders via Mental Care benefit
accidental burns or fractures medical expenses following dementia diagnosis
personal injury context described as falling/injuring oneself (via the one-time Medical Expense payout after accidental burns/fractures)
policies.coverage_term_description: Coverage up to 99 years old; Cognitive Care benefit for late dementia covers 10 years from diagnosis and policy terminates upon full payment of Cognitive Care payout.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Premium payment relief: stop paying for the policy and stay covered once diagnosed with late-stage dementia and receive the Cognitive Care Benefit.
policy_termination_events: Policy terminates upon the end of Cognitive Care payout (after full Cognitive Care payout).
important_caveats: All age mentioned are Age Next Birthday.
